verdictEs: WoWAnalyzer si quieres saber por qué tu DPS/HPS está por debajo del top: rotation mistakes, cooldown usage tardío, buff uptime suboptimo, todo per-spec con suggestions actionable. Wipefest si eres raid leader y necesitas saber por qué wiperon: qué mechanic falló, quién murió de qué, mechanic-by-mechanic breakdown.
verdictEn: WoWAnalyzer if you want to know why your DPS/HPS is below top: rotation mistakes, late cooldown usage, suboptimal buff uptime, all per-spec with actionable suggestions. Wipefest if you're a raid leader and need to know why the raid wiped: what mechanic failed, who died of what, mechanic-by-mechanic breakdown.

useCases.labelEs: Mejorar tu performance personal como DPS/healer
useCases.reasonEs: WoWAnalyzer es per-spec con suggestions específicos: 'has usado X cooldown 12 segundos tarde 3 veces', 'mantain Y buff at 95% uptime, tú tuviste 73%'. Wipefest no analiza individual DPS — su scope es mechanics.
useCases.reasonEn: WoWAnalyzer is per-spec with specific suggestions: 'you used X cooldown 12 seconds late 3 times', 'maintain Y buff at 95% uptime, you had 73%'. Wipefest doesn't analyze individual DPS — its scope is mechanics.

useCases.labelEs: Identificar por qué la raid wipeó en un boss
useCases.labelEn: Identify why the raid wiped on a boss
useCases.reasonEs: Wipefest construye timeline mecánico del pull: qué mechanic se ejecutó, quién la falló, en qué orden las muertes. Para raid leader es la tab obligatoria post-wipe. WoWAnalyzer no toca mechanics — solo individual rotation.
useCases.reasonEn: Wipefest builds a mechanical timeline of the pull: what mechanic fired, who failed it, in what order deaths happened. For raid leader it's the mandatory post-wipe tab. WoWAnalyzer doesn't touch mechanics — only individual rotation.

useCases.labelEs: Spec sin cobertura activa de WoWAnalyzer
useCases.reasonEs: WoWAnalyzer coverage es uneven — algunas specs tienen modules maintained, otras no. Si tu spec no tiene module activo, los suggestions son genericos o vacíos. Wipefest funciona universal porque su data es mechanics-level, no spec-level.
useCases.reasonEn: WoWAnalyzer coverage is uneven — some specs have maintained modules, others don't. If your spec lacks an active module, suggestions are generic or empty. Wipefest works universally because its data is mechanics-level, not spec-level.

useCases.labelEs: Identificar mechanic-specific deaths en un raid pull
useCases.labelEn: Identify mechanic-specific deaths in a raid pull
useCases.reasonEs: Wipefest construye breakdown por mechanic: 5 deaths a 'Searing Glare', 3 deaths a 'Stomp', 2 deaths overlapping debuffs. WoWAnalyzer reporta deaths individuales pero no agrupa por mechanic.
useCases.reasonEn: Wipefest builds per-mechanic breakdown: 5 deaths to 'Searing Glare', 3 deaths to 'Stomp', 2 deaths to overlapping debuffs. WoWAnalyzer reports individual deaths but doesn't aggregate by mechanic.

useCases.labelEs: Coaching individual: ver qué cooldown un player usó tarde
useCases.labelEn: Individual coaching: see what cooldown a player used late
useCases.reasonEs: WoWAnalyzer detalla timing exacto de cooldowns: 'usado a 2:34, óptimo era 1:58 (36 segundos late)'. Suggestions específicas por habit, no por mechanic. Wipefest no entra a este nivel de detalle individual.
useCases.reasonEn: WoWAnalyzer details exact cooldown timing: 'used at 2:34, optimal was 1:58 (36 seconds late)'. Specific suggestions per habit, not per mechanic. Wipefest doesn't go to this level of individual detail.
